title: fix(2d): Pass starts at (Auto/Inside/Outside) for 2D Offset
body:
## What changed

A 2D Offset with an Outside containment cut each level core-first. On the band between the stock reach and the part, the core is the middle of the band, so the first ring was a full slot in the stock (#3316). This PR adds the shared parameter `PassStart { Auto, Inside, Outside }` and gives it to 2D Offset only.

### After the second read (comment 7077845657)

The second read found that the first ring law (`PassStart::rank`, an order of whole loops) still cut the full tool width where a ring splits at a narrow place: a split piece is one closed loop with stock-side arcs and part-side arcs. The red meter agreed: 7.97 mm on the second read's band, 8697 full-width points on fig8. The ring law is replaced:

- `crates/geometry/src/geo2d/clip_line.rs` (new): `Region::clip_polyline` and `Region::clip_ring`, an open-path clip against a region. Each segment splits at every boundary crossing, and a piece is kept by the parity of its midpoint. The direction is kept, every point lies on the input, and the wrap of a ring is joined. NaN and out-of-range input give a clean error. Tests: degenerate input (empty, one point, zero length, a path on the boundary, an empty region).
- `crates/motion/src/machining2d/level_rings.rs` (new): Inside and Outside rings are level curves of the distance from the START side only. Outside: ring 0 is the stretch of the area's boundary on its outer edge; ring j is the outer edge (holes filled) eroded by j stepovers, clipped to the cutter-centre area as open pieces; the walls (the holes and the "Do not touch" keep-outs) come last, with the stock to leave. Inside is the mirror. Each piece is walked with the uncut side on the right for climb.
- `crates/motion/src/machining2d/level_order.rs` (new): each connected piece of the area is cut ring by ring, the nearest piece next. A piece joins the pass before it only by a chord that stays in the area, crosses no planned cut and runs through cut material (each sample within 0.9 tool radii of a walk already cut). Else the next pass starts on a vertex of a walk already cut, with a lead-in chord of the same law, so it re-enters a cleared column. The ends of the pieces are shared vertices of the boundary walks, so the crossing law reads touches.
- Keep-down pass links of this plan must also run through cleared columns (`ladder_links::through_cut`, `Motion::cleared_links`), else they lift by the existing rules (#3319 law).
- Visible warnings ("Pass start ..." notes; the op page shows each one as a `warning:` line, `approach_page::entry_status_lines`):
  - Outside, first ring on a wall: "Pass start Outside: the outer edge of this area is a wall in the stock, not the open stock edge, so each level starts with a cut of the full tool width along that wall".
  - Inside on an Outside band: "Pass start Inside: the inner edge of this area is the part wall, so each level starts with a cut of the full tool width along the part".
  - Inside round an island: "Pass start Inside: the inner edge of this area is an island wall, so each level starts with a cut of the full tool width along the island".
  - Each later cut at the full width: "Pass start <side>: N cut(s) take the full tool width where the area is narrower than the tool plus one stepover, or where a wall hides the start side; the first is at X .., Y ..".
  - The app passes the stock footprint in the area's frame (`operation/pass_start_stock.rs`), so a start ring in open air does not warn.
- `waterscan.rs` is main's file again; `PassStart::rank` is removed. Auto takes the old planner byte for byte (no golden changes).
- Texts corrected to what the tests prove: the `PassStart` docs, `docs/decisions/3316-pass-start-shared.md`, the hint in `pass_start_row.rs`, the `camcraft-mcp` skill row, the user guide (2D Offset, Pass starts at).
- New motion entry points `pocket_started_on` / `pocket_avoid_started_on` take a `StartSide` (start, stock footprint, around part); `pocket_started` / `pocket_avoid_started` keep a bare `PassStart`.

### After the third read (comment 7079896741, head 9939a6238)

The third read found a blocker: material nested in a hole stayed standing at full depth, with no warning. The Outside fill read the outer loops with `Region::new`, which turns a nested outer loop into a hole.

- `level_rings.rs`: each part of the material (an outer loop with the holes directly inside it) is planned from its own edges, at any depth of nesting (`material_parts`). Material inside a hole starts on its own edge (a wall in the stock: named by the wall-first warning). Inside on a part with no hole cuts that part from the middle outward, as Auto, with the note "Pass start Inside: N part(s) of this area have no hole to start from, so they are cut from the middle outward, as Auto cuts them". I did not take `Region::union_all` (the reader's proposal): it cuts the nested part with rings of the far outer edge, so its first cut lands in its middle at the full width.
- Completeness guard (`level_rings::unswept`): after the plan of a level, the passes are swept by the tool disc and compared with the cutter-centre area. If more than 0.1 mm2 stays unswept (read after a 50 um erosion), the plan is not posted. The level takes the Auto plan, and the toolpath says "Pass start <side>: the rings from the start side would leave A mm2 of this area uncut, so this area is cut in the Auto order instead". Recorded in the decision file.
- `clip_line.rs`: tests for a vertex exactly on the boundary, a tangent touch at a corner, and an overlap along a boundary edge in mid-segment.
- `pocket.rs` is 343 lines: `non_sliver_center` and its test moved to `pocket_plan.rs`. `levels.rs` did not grow in this fix (454 lines, 443 on main).
- Readings, shape-mask leftover (interior cells that the tool reaches and that stay uncut):
  - Ring-part fixture (stock 80 x 80, ring part 15..25): Outside on 9939a6238 153.7 mm2, 15103 interior cells; now 2.57 mm2, 0 interior cells. Inside now 2.63 mm2, 0 interior cells.
  - Hollow-boss pocket (80 x 60, boss radius 18, bore radius 10 cleared to the floor): Outside on 9939a6238 26.4 mm2, 1126 disallowed interior cells; now 15.1 mm2, all in the unreachable inside corners. Inside now 15.2 mm2, the same.
  - The "Do not touch" band: 10.8 mm2, all in the keep-out band of the pin (already true on 9939a6238; the check is new).

Unchanged from the first head: the type, the `OpParams` field, the project key `pass_start`, the MCP door, the Passes-tab row, the digest.

## Readings

Shape-mask meter (`crates/motion/tests/common/shape_mask.rs`, widest cut along every planar feed; a full-width cut reads 8 mm), tool radius 4, step 4:
- The second read's band (stock 84 x 24, reach 100 x 40, round part radius 15), Outside: 7.966 mm on 59b42c727, 4.866 mm now. Uncut 0.000 mm2, no overcut into the part.
- The same band with a "Do not touch" pin, Outside: 7.966 mm on 59b42c727, 4.866 mm now; no avoid hit.
- Inside from an open bore (ring of stock 15..40): 8.000 mm on 59b42c727, 4.522 mm now.

fig8.step, EM-0800-4FL, Outside containment, the maintainer's heights: planar feed points with uncut stock on both flanks (`offset_pass_start/flanks.rs`): 8697 on 59b42c727, 0 now. The first ring of each level starts 4.000 mm outside the stock, and each level ends on the part wall.

Cost on fig8 (debug, motion only): Auto 9.5 s, 24768 moves, 18 lateral rapids; Outside 26.6 s, 25986 moves, 93 lateral rapids, 15 % more feed length (lead-ins and the lifts between pieces).

## Pinning tests (red on 59b42c727, green now)

- `camcraft-motion` `pass_start_levels` (new):
  - `outside_band_split_by_the_part_cuts_no_move_at_full_width` (red: 7.966 mm).
  - `outside_band_with_a_do_not_touch_pin_cuts_no_move_at_full_width` (red: 7.966 mm).
  - `inside_from_an_open_bore_cuts_no_move_at_full_width` (red: 8.000 mm).
  - `the_wall_first_and_narrow_cases_are_named_on_the_path` (new API).
  - `the_start_side_plan_posts_no_crossing_feeds` (new).
  - `the_stock_inside_a_ring_part_is_cut_whole` (red on 9939a6238: 153.7 mm2 left).
  - `a_pocket_with_a_hollow_boss_is_cut_whole` (red on 9939a6238: 1126 disallowed interior cells).
  - `the_wall_first_and_narrow_cases_are_named_on_the_path` now also pins the core note and the narrow note (a horseshoe part whose mouth is narrower than the tool).
- `camcraft-motion` lib `level_rings::guard_tests::the_guard_reads_a_standing_core_and_passes_a_whole_plan` (new).
- `camcraft-app` `offset_pass_start`:
  - `fig8_outside_offset_cuts_no_move_at_full_width` (red: 8697 points; heavy lane).
  - `fig8_outside_offset_starts_each_level_at_the_stock_edge` (heavy lane now).
  - `fig8_inside_offset_names_its_part_wall_start` (new).
  - `fig8_auto_offset_keeps_every_lateral_rapid_at_the_clearance_plane`, `mcp_sets_pass_start_refuses_an_unknown_word_and_undo_restores_it` (unchanged).
- `camcraft-geometry` lib `geo2d::clip_line::tests` (4).
- `camcraft-motion` lib `pass_start::tests::auto_says_nothing_and_each_wall_case_is_named`.
- `camcraft-ui` lib `egui_app::tests::pass_start::a_pass_start_warning_is_a_status_line` (new).

The two fig8 Outside tests take about 170 s each in debug (one generation and its verify), so they are in the app heavy lane.

## Not exercised

- The UI by hand (no screenshots; the hint text and one status-line branch changed).
- A tilted setup with Inside / Outside (the stock footprint is projected in the op frame like the corner-relief law; not run).
- Two re-entry helices in one area can bore side by side, and the verifier then names a crossing: filed as #3397. The crossing test checks the planar feeds only.

## Follow-ups

- #3397 (P7): overlapping re-entry helices.
- The sub-issues #3354-#3362 name `PassStart::rank` as the shared ring law. That function is gone: the shared law is now `level_rings::ring_plan` with `level_order` (and `StartSide` for the stock). The fact is noted on #3316; the sub-issues are not edited.

Process change: yes

Changelog: 2D Offset: new "Pass starts at" option (Auto, Inside, Outside) on the Passes tab. Outside starts each level at the outer edge (with an Outside containment, outside the stock) and walks rings that follow that edge one stepover at a time, so the passes no longer slot the stock where the part splits the band. A cut that must still take the full tool width (the first ring along a wall, or a place narrower than the tool plus one stepover) shows a "Pass start" warning on the toolpath.

Effort: max (escalated from high)

Fixes #3316
